overall: MARGINAL, workable evening in the north
limiterDetail: Main limiter: wind , with showers as a second factor. The south and central grounds (Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot) build to 15–17 kt from ~7–9 PM and stay at 13–14 kt through Thursday midday. Coron, Culion and Galoc get light showers (~0.9 mm/h) from 3 to 5 PM, then dry out with wind under 6 kt until midnight. Tara and Turda currents run 1.0–1.2 kt from ~5 to 10 PM.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR · nothing active for Calamian / MIMAROPA (latest entries, Wed 5:20 AM PHT, are flood advisories for Davao Region only)

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: Saturday 17 dropped from GOOD to MARGINAL (ECMWF now 11 kt, gusts 18, ~9.0 mm; this morning it was 8.9 kt, ~4.6 mm). That pushes the supply refill back a day: the 3-day outlook goes from ABOVE NORMAL (from late Sat) back to NORMAL, softening. The refill now starts with Sunday's catch.

Wind is now the main problem for Thu–Fri, not rain. Thu 15 is windier (13 kt, gusts 18, was 11) but drier (~6.3 mm, was 14.5). Fri 16 is now the worst day (14 kt, gusts 20, ~10.8 mm; it was 11 kt and ~4.0 mm).
Today eased a little. Wednesday's rain total is down to ~8.7 mm (was ~14.4) and wind to 5.6 kt. Six grounds are GOOD right now (none were this morning). Today's overall rating stays MARGINAL.

shortageRisk: No surge detected. Shortage risk ELEVATED Wed → Tue 20 (unchanged), and the tightest stretch now runs Fri–Sat (was Thu–Fri). Stock up from tonight's and Thursday's arrivals; supply refills from Sunday evening, a day later than this morning's forecast.

bestWindow.headline: Tonight ~6 PM–midnight (north & west) · Thu ~1–6 AM (Tara, Turda, Decabobo)
details: ~6 PM to midnight on Maglalambay, Coron, Galoc and Culion: wind 1.6–6 kt, currents 0.2–0.6 kt (peaking ~8–9 PM), dry after the 3–5 PM showers. Maglalambay is the steadiest (current ≤0.4 kt).
Thu ~1–6 AM on Tara, Turda and Decabobo: currents drop to 0.1–0.5 kt with wind 2–3 kt and almost no rain. The model's single best hour in the next 24h is ~5 AM Thu at Decabobo.

Keep boats off Cabunlawan, Decabaitot and Nangalao from ~6 PM (15–17 kt peak ~7–9 PM, still 13–14 kt Thursday morning) and off Ciron Thu ~2–8 AM (15–16 kt). Alava is fine until ~6 PM, then 10–13 kt overnight.
